name: Amagi Asumi
source:
Affiliation: Elusion
Post: Captain
Birthplace: Japan (Shizuoka)

The daughter of a famous soldier known by both the EUG and ICSEO.
In order to become a symbol for the peace talks she becomes the captain of the Elusion.
